label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is host = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') (user input). Data flow: param from request → assigned to host variable → passed to openUrlByHostname(host) which constructs URL and opens connection. While there is DNS resolution (resolveHost) before the fetch, the isNonPublicAddress check only validates the resolved IP, not the original hostname. An attacker can provide a hostname that resolves to a public/internal IP they control, bypassing the check. The sink expression at line 45 (openUrlByHostname) receives attacker-controlled data.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request parameter
host variable assigned from param, passed to openUrlByHostname sink
openUrlByHostname sink constructs URL with host and opens connection
